semantics.type: Pure combinational state transition and Moore output logic; no state flip-flops
semantics.clock_reset_initialization: No clock, reset, storage, or initialization ports/behavior. Outputs follow current inputs after combinational settling.
semantics.encoding: state[i] represents active Si; multiple active bits are permitted; contributions combine by OR. Zero state gives zero next_state and outputs.

numeric.representation: Unsigned 10-bit bitsets and one-bit Boolean input/outputs
numeric.operations: Only Boolean AND, OR and NOT; no arithmetic, rounding, overflow, saturation, or truncation
numeric.bit_order: Bit i corresponds to Si for both state and next_state

verification.plan: Independent table-driven oracle: iterate all 1024 state bitsets and both input values; for each active source state OR its table-selected destination and Moore outputs. Compare all 12 output bits after settling.
verification.coverage: 2048 binary cases including zero-hot, every one-hot state, and all multi-hot combinations
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts; static inspection for combinational completeness

specification_ambiguities: X/Z input behavior is unspecified; exhaustive verification covers binary inputs only.
